description.en: Read when using Cybion: what the product is, the basic terms (Thread / Manual / Note), the two user-level manuals worth maintaining, Ultimate Machines, the NormAI multimodal tools and the Thread Token. Ships with the source, shared by every user, read-only, one manual with no child nodes.
description.zh: 使用 Cybion 时需要查看：产品是什么、基本术语（线程 / 手册 / 便签）、应当长期维护的两份用户级手册、终极机器、NormAI 多模态工具与 Thread Token。随源码发布、所有用户共享、只读，只有这一份，不分设子节点。
